pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregularly polygonal geometries with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are soft-to-moderate, lacking high-frequency sharp pixel transitions. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases significantly toward the lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous negative-space network of light-colored pelage pathways. Junction nodes consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central torso, providing high topological connectivity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck line presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D serrated contour against the background. Individual hair clusters create a jagged silhouette.
